name: Quintas de Leitura / Nas tuas mãos começa o precipício
description: This event is a poetic evening featuring specialists in the art of poetry, inspired by a verse from Luís Miguel Nava. It includes contemporary circus, music, and readings.
longDescription:
Quintas de Leitura presents "Nas tuas mãos começa o precipício," a poetic evening at TMP-Campo Alegre in Porto. The event is scheduled for December 17, 2026, starting at 10:00 PM and lasting 90 minutes.

The program features a blend of image, contemporary circus, music, and poetry readings. Performers include Mau Jara, José Anjos, Paulo Campos dos Reis, António Durães, Susana Menezes, Mia Tomé, João Salcedo, Femme Falafel, Lavoisier, and Mariana, a Miserável. João Gesta curates the evening.

Tickets are priced at 9€ for plateia seating, with discounts available for group bookings, Porto.Card holders, students, and those over 65. The event is promoted by Ágora - Cultura e Desporto do Porto, E.M., S.A. The venue is located at Rua das Estrelas, 4150-762 Porto.
